name: arithmetic
title: Basic arithmetic and division edge cases
measures: +, -, *, /, and % on positive and negative integers, including truncating division and the sign of the remainder (C01, C06).
notes: RuneScript's int / int truncates toward zero; TypeScript's / is float division. The TS version truncates explicitly (trunc), so both print the same values: this checks that RuneScript matches the C/ActionScript-style integer rules a TS developer would write by hand.
